escalations.detail: Both were the lowest-id eligible cards at boot and neither was taken. PR #123 was opened at 02:00:00Z, four seconds before this run started, and it carried board edits to exactly these two cards, blocking both on ivan. It has since merged as 942b6bf. The claims map was empty and could not have prevented the overlap: a claim protects a card only once its pull request is on main. Skipped per CLAUDE.md section 13 and logged here rather than skipped quietly. Nothing was lost, because #123 reached the same conclusion this run would have.

escalations.text: The harness reads docs/board/rc-board-phase2.json (POC_BOARD, scripts/poc/run.sh line 23) while every run since 2026-08-30 has worked docs/board/rc-board-phase3.json. Its eligible-card line, the CLAIM_SKIPPED set it puts in the prompt, and the claim it writes at the end of a run are all computed against a board nobody is working. Visible right now in this file: a claim on AUT-10 by harness, written at the end of a run that worked P3-11. Nothing was lost today because the session reads both boards at boot, but the lease is protecting the wrong card and the lease exists because a human terminal and the harness collided once already. Needs a card against scripts/poc/run.sh. See docs/reports/2026-08-31-executor-p3-13-deviz-schema.md section 3b.
